settings.title: 14-day returns
settings.text: Change your mind within 14 days of delivery

Delivery is free to England, Scotland and Wales on panels and furniture. Orders are dispatched the next working day and usually arrive in 3–5 working days.

Northern Ireland: £5 per box, shown at checkout before you pay.

Fabric swatches have one flat £3.50 postage charge per order, however many colours you choose.

Larger orders may arrive in more than one parcel, and panels and swatches can arrive separately. Each delivery note lists what’s inside. If something seems to be missing, email us your order number and we’ll sort it out.

We can’t change an order once it’s placed, but we can cancel it before it’s dispatched so you can order again.

You can cancel any order within 14 days of the day after it arrives, for any reason. Tell us by email at info@vantpanels.co.uk or call 020 3355 9166, then send the items back within 14 days.

Return postage: you pay to send items back. Panels and furniture need a courier: use any tracked courier, or we can book FedEx for you and tell you the cost first. As a guide, one box of panels costs up to £20.

Your refund: we refund the price and any delivery charge you paid within 14 days of receiving your return (or your proof of sending it), to your original payment method. Please return items in their original packaging if you still have it. If panels have been fitted to a wall or damaged, we may reduce your refund to reflect the loss in value, and we’ll show you why.

Faulty or damaged items: contact us first and we’ll arrange the return at our cost. You’re entitled to a full refund within 30 days of delivery, or a repair or replacement after that.

To exchange an item, return it and place a new order. If you refuse a delivery, we refund you less the cost of bringing it back to us.

Swatch postage isn’t refundable once swatches are sent.

Returns address: Vänt Panels, Unit 1 Avon Mill Industrial Estate, Mill Road, Linlithgow Bridge, EH49 7QY.

Full details are in our Terms & Conditions.

Your Vänt furniture and panels have a 1-year warranty from the date of purchase. It covers manufacturing defects in frames, brackets and aluminium parts.

We’ll repair or replace a faulty item free of charge (excluding delivery). The warranty doesn’t cover damage to the upholstery, such as stains, holes or tears, or damage from misuse. Products need to be fitted and used as described in our instructions. Replacing a part doesn’t restart the warranty.

This doesn’t affect your statutory rights.
